caption: The drawing depicts a single, long dining bench colored in reddish-brown. The bench has a simple, rectangular top with three supporting legs spaced evenly underneath. Each leg features a cross-braced support design. The bench sits on a plain, off-white background with various faint yellowish stains or patches scattered across the surface. There is a shadow below and to the left of the bench, suggesting light coming from the upper right. Below the bench, the words "Long Dining Bench" are written in a simple, grayish font. No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
title: Shaker Long House Bench
